scope: One real image through the current vision prompt/model, normal Flask vision and reviewed-selection routes, actual local datasets/matcher, and isolated temporary SQLite. Not a deployed scanner, Android, confirmation, nutrition preview, or meal-save acceptance.

input.transformation: none; original bytes were base64 encoded
input.visible_logo: A logo is visible in the corner, separate from the apple and with no evidence it identifies the food brand. The model returned brand=null.

isolation.database: Dedicated temporary SQLite, closed and directory removed
isolation.authentication: Test-only owner/session verifier; not password login acceptance
isolation.reviewed_source: 171688 installed only in the temporary SQLite for the ordinary reviewed-selection handler

identity.visual_evidence_reported_by_model: 畫面中央成人手掌中托著1顆完整的紅黃色生鮮蘋果，果皮與果梗完整且未經烹調或去皮。

local_lookup.classification: genuine local miss for this normalized identity and state; not a dataset-health failure

reviewed_usda_fdc_selection.identity: generic raw apple with skin; no cultivar inferred

interpretation: The existing vision request already returned a generic food identity, visible skin/state evidence, alternatives and uncertainty fields; a second image-model call is not needed for the proposed sequence.
A single model response at confidence 0.98 is an observation, not calibrated accuracy or proof of cultivar. The weight confidence was only 0.5 and 180 g is an estimate, not a measurement.
Both local layers missed, so the existing explicitly reviewed USDA FDC 171688 source was selected as a pending reference. No Detail request, user confirmation or preview occurred.
No Tavily call was made: the normal pipeline found a compatible reviewed USDA source. This test does not establish the behavior or credibility of any Tavily result.

three_layer_design_review.vision_stage: Return a conservative canonical display name plus visible evidence, food state/scope, explicitly supported variant, and alternatives/uncertainty. Never infer cultivar, brand or hidden ingredients from likely appearance alone.
three_layer_design_review.retrieval_order: Keep TFDA then compatible USDA/FDC. Only a genuine, healthy-dataset local miss may enter an admitted Web/Tavily source path; incompatible, ambiguous-identity, partial-profile and unavailable are different outcomes, not search misses.
three_layer_design_review.tavily_role: Search for permitted nutrition sources using the already recognized generic identity and visible state/scope; do not send the image, health data or unsupported identity guesses. Tavily relevance score is not food-match confidence.
three_layer_design_review.model_extraction_role: Use the fixed structured extraction prompt on retrieved source text only; return candidate food identity, original serving basis, units, nutrient cells and citations. Do not use model memory to invent values or use nutrition-page contents to resolve what the image depicts.
three_layer_design_review.adoption_gate: Backend independently verifies exact food/state/scope compatibility, source rights/admission, original cited values, units, completeness/unknowns, ranges and arithmetic. Keep image identity confidence separate from source compatibility and nutrition provenance. On uncertainty, return unresolved and ask the user rather than fabricate precision.
three_layer_design_review.activation_status: Planning clarification only. Production Tavily registry remains empty and automatic Web fallback remains disabled.

limitations_and_next: Normal Flask test_client routes with temporary SQLite are not the deployed HTTPS scanner, real Android gallery/camera flow, user confirmation or preview acceptance.
One image/model call does not establish general recognition, state, skin, cultivar, confidence calibration, weight or nutrition accuracy.

Next: have the user run this original image through the ordinary scanner page and capture the pending generic apple/reference confirmation. Do not confirm or save on the user's behalf; do not force a local miss or repeat the fixed fixture.
No Tavily activation, new Web-source admission, profile acceptance, meal write, broader UI or additional workstream is authorized by this experiment.
